content: flick is bin-only: put characterization/integration tests in cfg(test) src/characterization/ using only crate:: paths, because tests/ cannot see bin internals

description: Case-variant fixtures (DEV.X next to dev.x) collapse into one entry on case-insensitive APFS, double-counting sizes
resolution: Test case-sensitivity on pure name-matching functions, not on disk

description: Thread-timing tests with fixed sleeps (50-150 ms windows) pass locally but fail on loaded CI coverage runs (sys::poll timer, message press/local-run, herdr jump).
resolution: Wait on a condition with a generous deadline (15 s): Worker::running() (Arc strong count), queue notes together so one drain handles them, or poll for the expected state. Never assert a count after a fixed sleep.

description: A fake worker can finish inside the same drain that started it, so a test that queues a dismissal/repost after that drain races the result.
resolution: Queue the dismissal with the presses before the drain, or call the enqueue method directly.

description: A 'stale socket' test file made by binding and dropping a UnixListener can stay live: on macOS Rust sets close-on-exec after creating the socket, so a child spawned by another test in that gap inherits it.
resolution: Create the stale socket file with UnixDatagram::bind (PR #47).

content: Parallel test runs share ephemeral ports and the user's Trash: never assume a freed port stays free or a fixed Trash file name is unique.

description: llm chat tests: asserting only("notice", log) == [one line] after send() is flaky: the fake UI logs the notice on every redraw, and how many ModuleChanged drains a stream takes is timing-dependent.
resolution: Assert the last logged notice (only(..).pop()) or m.chat.notice, not the full list.
